Eating it as is will provide a temporary boost to your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Icy Gourmet Meats are a type of [[Frozen Food]], which is made by freezing [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] in a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Being frozen, Icy Gourmet Meats are easier to transport, and they are able to retain their flavor. Eating one will restore three [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] and grant one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Icy Gourmet Meats reappear as a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Raw Gourmet Meat]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Icy Gourmet Meats are able to retain their flavor despite being frozen, and they are easier to transport than regular Raw Gourmet Meats. If [[Link]] eats one, he will heal three [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]], in addition to receiving one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Icy Meat * Icy Prime Meat * Raw Gourmet Meat * Seared Gourmet Steak }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats |items= BotW, TotK }}
